## Problem

Describe the reusable consumer or maintainer problem this change solves.

## Approach

Explain the chosen implementation, meaningful alternatives, and why this belongs in the core crate, an adapter, an example, or documentation.

## Verification

List the exact commands, tests, fixtures, benchmarks, or independent checks performed.

## API and compatibility

- [ ] No public API changes.
- [ ] Public API changes are documented and assessed for pre-1.0 compatibility.
- [ ] Breaking or transitional behavior has explicit maintainer approval and migration guidance.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] The change uses only synthetic or public test data.
- [ ] Threats, failure behavior, resource limits, Unicode or span implications, and false-positive or false-negative risks are documented where relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, confidential material, production secrets, or customer content are included.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes include independent verification, not only tests generated from the same implementation assumptions.

## Provenance and licensing

- [ ] Relevant specifications, prior art, source projects, datasets, algorithms, regexes, and licenses are identified.
- [ ] Copied or adapted material is explicitly attributed.
- [ ] I can explain and take responsibility for any AI-assisted content.

## Documentation and evidence

- [ ] README, rustdoc, guides, ADRs, changelog, examples, and migration documentation are updated where required.
- [ ] Claims are labeled honestly as implemented, measured, or planned.
- [ ] New recognizers include positive, near-miss, invalid, false-positive, locale or jurisdiction, and confidence-rationale evidence.

## Contribution intake

- [ ] Every commit includes a valid `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [ ] I have reviewed the Contributor License Agreement and contribution policy.
- [ ] I understand that outside contributions may be reviewed but will not be merged until the CLA acceptance process is approved.

## Remaining limitations

State what this change intentionally does not solve.
